description: This Kotlin source file defines a Fragment class named DashboardFragment for an Android smart home TV control app. It manages UI components representing device controls (Smart Light, Fan, Air Conditioner), handles user interactions, focus navigation, and updates UI state with Toast notifications on toggle actions.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays focusable device cards allowing toggles with visual focus cues and Toast feedback.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up device card UI components with toggle behavior, focus effects, and click listeners.

methods.name: updateCardUI
methods.description: Updates the UI of a device card based on the device's ON/OFF state.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DashboardFragment.
